text.c637ae3827a48595e736: If pre-warrant equity / shares exceeds strike, price = (pre-warrant equity + strike * eligibleWarrantShares) / (shares + eligibleWarrantShares); otherwise use pre-warrant equity / shares. Floor negative equity at zero for common price.

text.9e5b67566c41a72f3e28: With constant final growth g and margin m, explicit reinvestment = (R_t - R_t-1) * (1+g)*m*(1-tax)/ROIC = NOPAT_t*g/ROIC. Thus final FCFF*(1+g) equals terminal-year NOPAT*(1-g/ROIC). The (1+g) factor matches the existing engine contemporaneous delta-sales convention to its terminal g/ROIC convention.

text.7b76a85a34a4182e558b: The issuer reported Q2 2026 revenue of $191.9m and guided Q3 to $255–290m. A front-loaded growth path with a fast decline from 60% to 40%, 30% and 20% is a bounded analyst illustration of ramp then slowdown, not a forecast derived directly from units or guidance.
text.127f4f9d61e789014561: Management described approximate 200,000 monthly capacity and an expected 650,000 by year-end 2026. Capacity is not recognized revenue or guaranteed utilization; no direct multiplication of capacity by an invented selling price is used.
text.972fbaed3460234cb640: The initial margin is reported GAAP TTM EBIT/revenue. Conditional break-even by year 2 and 12% mature margin by year 6 are analyst operating-leverage judgments; non-GAAP net income is not substituted for GAAP EBIT.
text.96b915f0730c09898c1b: Initial 0.8x sales/capital remains a conservative capital-heavy input; the temporary twofold utilization improvement is assumed, motivated by already funded construction and equipment prepayments, not by a verified incremental asset-turnover ratio.
text.bc02d7baf515fe9026e4: Capital intensity subsequently converges to the independently specified mature marginal ROIC, allowing competitive erosion of the higher mid-ramp return and eliminating a mechanical terminal reinvestment jump.
